fusions.name: Blood Cartridge
fusions.desc: Spends 5% of your maximum health to fire a round at the first enemy it meets, dealing 9 damage. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Powder Burst
fusions.desc: Looses a wide cone ahead that deals 14 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1 second. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Crouched Aim
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Next in Line
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a bolt of lightning leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
